title: Balance and lock a counterweighted service arm
instruction: Support the loaded arm, slide its counterweight until the pin holes align at the orange index, insert the locking pin through both holes, and leave the arm level with both hands clear.
context: Adjusting a support arm for a changed tool load requires changing its gravitational moment and retaining the setting before releasing the load.
setup: Bimanual YAM station; x forward, y left, z up; metres/kg/radians; XYZW quaternions. Tabletop z=0.7475 m. Fixed layout, seed 0, no object jitter. Each object below is an authored rigid body; dimensions are collision envelopes. The following origins and orientations describe zero-joint authored frames. Actual reset starts arm_pivot at +0.3 rad and weight_slide at 0 m, giving service_arm XYZW (0,0.149438,0,0.988771) and counterweight origin (0.257474,0,0.876950) m with the same reset orientation. Shapes, local offsets, colors, contact-material coefficients and joints are enumerated in scene.json and SETUP.md. pedestal made from aluminium fixture surrogate, 1.2 kg, envelope (0.13, 0.12, 0.104) m, origin (0.285, 0, 0.7475), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). service_arm made from aluminium service-arm and tool-load surrogate, 0.36 kg, envelope (0.29, 0.246, 0.063) m, origin (0.285, 0, 0.8475), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). counterweight made from steel counterweight with rigid polymer grasp handles, 0.3 kg, envelope (0.044, 0.098, 0.0855) m, origin (0.25, 0, 0.8675), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). locking_pin made from steel locating pin surrogate, 0.025 kg, envelope (0.022, 0.022, 0.064) m, origin (0.32, -0.24, 0.7757), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). pin_stand made from anchored steel locating-fixture surrogate, 0.12 kg, envelope (0.022, 0.022, 0.014) m, origin (0.32, -0.24, 0.7475), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). The simulation uses explicit lumped masses and centres of mass with common static/dynamic friction 0.65/0.5.
scoring: 0.3 when the stationary counterweight slider is between -32 and -30 mm. Add 0.3 when the pin centre is within 1.5 mm of (-66,0,-4) mm in the arm frame and its orientation is within 0.105 rad of the arm. Add 0.4 when the arm angle is within ±0.04 rad and the aligned weight and pin remain seated. Full score requires all bodies below 0.01 m/s and 0.2 rad/s, robot clearance at least 20 mm, and 3 seconds of stability. Otherwise the maximum is 0.95. Dropped parts, displaced fixtures and prohibited penetration over 2 mm invalidate the trial.
run_limit: 4800 control actions at 20 Hz (240 simulated seconds maximum)
reset_notes: Native reset restores the fixed assembly, sets arm_pivot to +0.3 rad and weight_slide to 0 m, settles the free pin, clears scorer history and records a new episode. Two-reset native probes verify placement within 3 mm. Seed 0; object_jitter=0.
fidelity: A damped, unpowered pivot and explicit mass/center-of-mass values model a loaded service arm. Prismatic guidance approximates the counterweight rail. A free pin enters collision-defined holes. The pivot has no centering spring. Rigid chamfer faces guide the locating pin into tight bearing sections.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0; fixed-action expert demo: 1.0; independent fresh-checkout repeat: 1.0
